entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-07
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/8.0.4xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #51631
  • backport VS Release fix to 8.0.3xx #51629
  • Backport vs release fix to 8.0.1xx #51627
  • Backport VS Release Images fix #51625
  • Separate command parsing from implementation #51623
  • `dotnet new gitignore` should only list actual .NET files #51616
  • Revise the behavior of MTP dotnet test when the test apps write to the console #51615
  • `dotnet run` doesn't work if project exceeds `MAX_PATH` #51610
  • `dotnet test` for MTP throws hard-to-interpret KeyNotFoundException #51608
  • `dotnetUp` hostfxr / muxer replacement logic is incomplete #51602
  • `dotnetUp` should detect admin installs on Unix #51601

Closed

  • dotnet watch 9.0 regression: killing process without further information #45024
  • error MSB6006: "dotnet" exited with code 1. With dotnet 5.0.100-preview8 #13127
  • MSTest.Sdk - Application Manifest For Registration Free COM #50202
